label: Verify checkout identity and branch
command: pwd && git worktree list && git remote get-url origin && git branch --show-current && git status --short

label: Read scoped instructions and integration code map
command: rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g "!**/.env*" -g "!**/credentials*" -g "!**/*lock*" app tests docs pyproject.toml README.md && sed -n "1,200p" app/schemas.py && sed -n "1,240p" tests/conftest.py && cat pyproject.toml

label: Inspect router and test inventory
command: rg --files -g "!**/.env*" -g "!**/credentials*" app tests docs .github | head -120 && cat pyproject.toml && sed -n "1,240p" app/main.py && rg -n "TestClient|ASGITransport|fixture|openapi|schema" tests

label: Read public contract handlers and safe local fixture
command: sed -n "1,260p" tests/test_support.py && sed -n "1,300p" app/routers/approvals.py && sed -n "1,240p" app/routers/tenants.py && sed -n "1,220p" app/routers/audit.py && sed -n "1,240p" app/routers/approver_contacts.py

label: Inspect API baseline and boundary coverage
command: sed -n "1,240p" tests/test_schemas.py && sed -n "1,240p" tests/test_routes.py && sed -n "1,200p" app/services/pagination.py && sed -n "1,200p" app/services/approval_service.py && sed -n "1,200p" .github/workflows/ci.yml && rg -n "contract|openapi|baseline|timeout_seconds|recovery" README.md docs/openapi.baseline.json scripts

label: Inspect existing consumer-contract cases and generated schema baseline structure
command: sed -n "1,260p" tests/test_middleware_contract.py && sed -n "1,180p" app/models.py && sed -n "1,220p" tests/test_coverage_audit_router.py && python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open(\"docs/openapi.baseline.json\")); print(json.dumps({\"approval_request\":s[\"components\"][\"schemas\"][\"ApprovalCreate\"], \"approval_response\":s[\"paths\"][\"/v1/approvals\"][\"post\"][\"responses\"], \"csv_response\":s[\"paths\"][\"/v1/audit-events.csv\"][\"get\"][\"responses\"], \"paths\":list(s[\"paths\"])}, indent=2))"

label: Inspect command safety wrapper and schema import path
command: sed -n "1,240p" docs/qa/2026-10-02/run.py && rg -n "class Settings|env_file|DATABASE_URL|READ_DATABASE|REDIS_URL|SENTRY|DEFAULT_APPROVERS" app/config.py && rg -n "response_model|response_class|responses=" app/routers app/main.py && rg --files docs/qa/2026-10-02 -g "*.py"

label: Run isolated API consumer contract tests
Confirm three contract defects with expected-failure marks disabled
command: .venv/bin/python docs/qa/2026-10-02/pytest_safe.py tests/test_qa_contract.py -q --no-cov --tb=short --runxfail -k "openapi_types or openapi_declares or openapi_csv"

label: Read safe runtime bootstrap and capture contract source locations
command: sed -n "1,220p" docs/qa/2026-10-02/pytest_safe.py && nl -ba app/schemas.py | head -95 && nl -ba app/routers/approvals.py | head -150 && nl -ba app/routers/audit.py | sed -n "132,220p" && nl -ba tests/test_qa_contract.py | sed -n "75,210p"

label: Compare runtime OpenAPI contract to committed baseline without network
Confirm every documented contract gap independently
command: .venv/bin/python docs/qa/2026-10-02/pytest_safe.py tests/test_qa_contract.py -q --no-cov --tb=short --runxfail -k "openapi_types or openapi_declares or openapi_csv"
